root_cause.text: The function `rxrpc_server_keyring()` overwrites `rx->securities` on every call without first releasing the reference count of the previously assigned keyring, causing a reference leak when called multiple times.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds a guard `if (rx->securities) return -EINVAL;` at the beginning of `rxrpc_server_keyring()`, preventing re-entry and thus the overwrite that would leak the previous keyring's reference.
